entities.name: Egon
entities.description: God of death from Kaldheim, one of the oldest Skoti, who ages backward and looks like a bitter teenage boy.

entities.name: Kolvori
entities.description: God who shares Egon's concern about the Skoti's downfall but does not get along with him.

entities.name: Narfi
entities.description: King of Karfell tricked by Egon.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: Enemies of the Skoti in an ancient war.

entities.name: Istfell
entities.description: Realm of the dead where Egon spends his time.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm Egon has long tried to enter.

entities.name: Firja
entities.description: Valkyrie who stops Egon's attempts to invade Starnheim.

entities.name: Ranar
entities.description: Warrior spirit appointed guardian of the passage between Istfell and Starnheim.

events.summary: During the Skoti's war with the Einir, Egon tricks King Narfi into giving him an army of the dead, turning the tide and making him god of the dead.
For centuries Egon tries to force his way into Starnheim and is stopped by Firja and Ranar.
events.quote: Egon is stopped by Firja and the warrior spirit Ranar

relations.note: Appointed by the valkyrie as guardian
relations.quote: appointed by the valkyrie as guardian of the passage
he proclaims himself the Lord High Ruler of the Lands of Istfell
